test_cases.what_to_try: On the chat screen, press the ghost in the top-right corner. Then, without help, find the way back to the ordinary chat screen. Tell me whether you knew that the cross in that corner was the way back.

test_cases.what_happened: I pressed the little ghost in the top right corner. After a short pause the screen changed. At the top it said 'Incognito chat'. In the middle there was a large black ghost and the sentence 'Incognito chats stay out of your history and search, and aren't used to train Claude.', with 'Learn more' underneath. In the corner where my ghost had been there was now a cross. The big ghost in the middle told me that the little ghost had brought me here, so I did make that connection once I was on this screen. I pressed the cross because a cross means close to me, and after another short pause I was back on the ordinary screen with the little ghost in the corner again. I could finish, and I did it without help. But I did not know beforehand what the ghost would do. I only understood it by pressing it and reading the words that appeared. I got back because I trust a cross, not because anything told me that the cross undid the ghost. Tomorrow I would not remember that the ghost means 'Incognito chat'.
